methods.description: Read quartile boundaries and estimate proportions by counting the required quarters, including a union of the two outer quarters.
Multiply the estimated proportion by the total to estimate a group count; mean and geometric region width do not determine this proportion.
Use a given quarter or half count to estimate the total by dividing by its proportion, or multiplying by four or two.
